artifact: independent compact audit of the completed Stage 11 full development bundle
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

decision_label_audit.explanation: The code maps either a latent-fidelity failure or a native-planner non-harm failure to STOP_NATIVE_FIDELITY_FAILURE. In this run the formal latent-fidelity constraint passed; the failed safety condition was PushT native-planner non-harm.

unseen_geometry.specificity_caveat: Matched beat shuffled by point estimate in every projection and horizon. PushT intervals were consistently stronger; Wall matched-versus-shuffled task intervals were weak at horizons 1 and 6 despite positive point estimates.

fresh_readout_planning.interpretation: Wall has a substantial but projection-unstable actionable signal. PushT has only a sparse horizon-6 regret gain and fails robust joint regret/ranking transfer.

native_planner.interpretation: The interval includes zero, so this is not conclusive evidence of harm, but it violates the prospective point-estimate non-harm tolerance.

latent_fidelity.undertrained_controls: All three Wall latent-only controls selected epoch 32 at the unresolved final boundary; no matched ARGA checkpoint was unresolved.

supported: The JEPA action path can be trained to improve correct state-specific relative action/outcome geometry.
The geometry improvement transfers to five unseen random projections in both environments.
The matched correspondence has information beyond ordinary latent-only adaptation and shuffled action/outcome correspondence, most clearly in PushT and Wall horizon 3.
In Wall, improved action geometry can produce large average fresh-readout regret and ranking gains.
not_supported: A robust cross-environment improvement in action selection.
Reliable improvement of JEPA's native goal-latent planner.
Confirmatory generalization to a numerically new task family.
An ICLR-ready claim that ARGA alone solves counterfactual planning.
scientific_interpretation.localized_bottleneck: The transition action-effect geometry is now repairable; the remaining bottleneck is the interface between that geometry, the goal representation, and the planner's scoring metric.

recommended_next_experiment.name: frozen-ARGA goal-metric bridge
recommended_next_experiment.core_design: Freeze matched Stage 11 action paths. Fit a low-capacity positive-semidefinite latent goal metric using target-token/goal pairs on training tasks only, then apply the identical frozen metric to frozen-JEPA and ARGA rollouts. Require ARGA plus the shared metric to beat frozen JEPA plus the same metric on new tasks.
recommended_next_experiment.why: Centered action geometry deliberately removes common-mode components, whereas native squared goal distance depends on relative action effects, the goal direction, and common-mode state. A shared goal metric tests whether the repaired dynamics become actionable without allowing a downstream head to hide dynamics errors.
do_not_do: Do not rerun ARGA for more epochs.
Do not train another unconstrained high-capacity decision head.
Do not claim confirmation on the inspected Stage 5 task family.
